description: Native reference-distill search-aware preflight. Train the rejected native-32 parent toward the reference engine's actual 300k root choices, while preserving the parent with broad init distillation.

metadata.parent_result: Corrected native-32 validation rejected the parent: model gate top1 647/1409 on oracle/child targets, corrected 300k search top1 560/1409, compare all 207 candidate-better vs 553 reference-better, capped -35908.
metadata.reference_distill_targets: runs/native-searchaware-reference-distill-targets-20260525/reference_distill_targets.jsonl: 1400 targets retargeted from the unified corpus to the reference engine's 300k selected root move. Parent baseline on this corpus is 491/1400 top1 and 856/1400 top3.
metadata.hypothesis: The prior child-eval target was a false positive because the model could rank a child first while search still rejected the move. Retargeting to the reference engine's searched root move should test whether explicit reference-search policy can improve move choice without another scalar continuation blend.
metadata.gate: Preflight only. The exported .pt/.nn model gate must exceed 540/1400 top1 on the reference-distill corpus before any corrected native-32 search gate is worth running.
metadata.decision: Run only as a preflight. If it clears the model gate, validate with corrected native-32 search_target_gate using --require-native-net-load on the unified corpus at 10k nodes before any broader gate.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must beat parent reference-distill baseline 491/1400 and clear 540/1400 top1.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Run corrected native-32 search_target_gate with --require-native-net-load on the unified corpus at 10k nodes.
validation.hard_stop: Reject immediately if the model gate fails or if the unified 10k gate is not better than parent.
